run_show_performance_bop19: run the BOP19 performance script to show metrics and plot recall curves for pose estimation results
run_plot_recall_curves: run plot_recall_curves to visualize BOP19 recall curves for VSD, MSSD, and MSPD error metrics
run_bop19_eval_with_custom_visib_gt_min: run the BOP19 performance script with a custom minimum visible surface fraction threshold
run_bop19_eval_with_multiple_results: run the BOP19 performance script with comma-separated result filenames to evaluate multiple datasets
review_plot_recall_curves: review the plot_recall_curves function that generates matplotlib recall plots for BOP19 pose estimation metrics
